rationale: New trainer composes a binary-win XGBRanker with a XGBRegressor EV gate — the only architectural class to historically clear 6/7 windows (claude #159, avg WR 65.5%). Default HPs (ev_floor=0.1, ev_scale=30) over-compress final scores so the threshold sweep degrades to thr=0.0 in 4/7 windows; W6 still cleared at WR 42.1% / +142.1% ann / 10.4% DD, proving the structural concept. Train mode should sweep ev_floor∈[0.0, 0.5] (widen score headroom), ev_scale∈[10, 100] (gate steepness), and ndcg_at∈{1,2,3} jointly with tree HPs. Higher ev_floor (~0.3-0.5) is the priority direction because the current 0.1 squashes too many days below thr=0.30.
